text:
Ivy (Design): quick design critique — autoscale row. main asks: make min/max intent crystal, show burst affordance, decide SLO slider coupling. attached mock.

Marco (PM): customers ask if max is strict. we need copy that says when bursts can exceed max.

Dev (Frontend): note: our stepper component supports aria; pooling sometimes hides inputs. we'll need to keep inputs consistent across pool types.

Ivy (Design): propose label: 'Max GPUs' + muted line 'soft cap — bursts possible (info)'. info opens tooltip with rules.

Sam (A11y): prefer short visible label + aria-describedby pointing to explanation text hidden visually. ensure slider ticks have aria-valuetext.

Priya (Backend): min/max stored as absolute counts; burst is a pool boolean. toggling burst updates pool and may trigger reconciliation — warn users on change.

Rae (Research): tested earlier copy: users expected slider moves to change numbers. suggest explicit control to avoid surprise.

Ivy (Design): options: auto-suggest vs explicit sync. leaning explicit: small chain-toggle between slider and inputs to sync.

Dev (Frontend): chain-toggle doable as a toggle button with aria-pressed. when synced, editing updates both; debounce updates client-side (700ms) to avoid thrash.

Sam (A11y): +1. use polite aria-live to announce 'synced' state; ensure chain icon contrast >=4.5:1. focus order: slider, sync button, min, max.

Marco (PM): draft modal copy for pool change: 'Switching to [Pool] may change recommended capacity because hardware differs. Review suggested min/max or keep current values.' CTAs: 'Review suggested values' / 'Keep current values'.

Priya (Backend): will add ticket for modal + feature flag (TICKET-5981).

Ivy (Design): action items: short labels, muted example under max (e.g., 'steady 4 GPUs; bursts up to 6'), chain-toggle with aria, tooltip for burst rules, pool-switch modal. I'll update figma and drop final strings here.

Rae (Research): will run a 6-person follow-up on the chain toggle next week.

Dev (Frontend): :thumbsup: — please attach exact copy and icon svg so I can size & implement.

Sam (A11y): left two small a11y notes in figma comments (aria-live wording + contrast). otherwise :thumbsup:.
